Quiet finish a friendly note for anyone travelling with a pet
Please read this before you travel
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should check their travel details early and make sure every document is ready before departure.

Please keep your pet secure, follow cabin and crate guidance, and let staff know about any change in your plans as soon as possible. The Companion Animal Travel Desk records service updates in the desk ledger so the right support can be given at the airport.

If a concern needs review, staff will follow a calm stepwise process and guide you through the next action. This helps protect your pet, your booking, and other travelers.

For help with any pet travel matter, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
